title: Julien Tiny Head - Hidden Gestral Arena Boss
description: Julien Tiny Head is fought in Expedition 33's Hidden Gestral Arena alongside Matthieu the Colossus and the Big Hands brothers. Location and arena context.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
Julien Tiny Head is an optional boss fought in the Hidden Gestral Arena, as part of the same Arena tournament that includes Matthieu the Colossus, Bertard Big Hands and Dominique Giant Feet.

Like the rest of the Arena set, these are solo duels - you fight with a single character and cannot rely on party synergy.

sections.title: Where to Find Julien Tiny Head
sections.content:
Location: Hidden Gestral Arena.

Enter the Arena tournament to meet the lineup. The Arena is also the route to the Medalum weapon - to claim it you must duel Sciel as Maelle.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
No documented elemental weakness for Julien Tiny Head.

Arena opponents in the Hidden Gestral Arena are designed as 1v1 skill checks rather than elemental puzzles - the deciding factor is reading attack timing, not damage type.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
Julien Tiny Head's specific drop is not documented in the sources we could verify.

Defeating the Arena roster is the route to the Medalum weapon, which requires duelling Sciel as Maelle later in the tournament.

sections.title: Fighting in the Hidden Gestral Arena
sections.content:
Because Arena fights are 1v1, the general rules differ from the rest of the game:

  • Bring your most self-sufficient character, not your best support unit
  • Parry windows matter more than build theory - you have no ally to cover a missed read
  • Expect fast, aggressive opponents rather than large telegraphed ones

Matthieu the Colossus is the best-documented opponent in this set - his left-handed hook and uppercut timings are well mapped, and the same read-and-parry approach applies across the Arena roster.

map.directions: Enter the Arena tournament to meet the roster.
